title: CompactParams
description:
Params of the `engine/compact` RPC.

`trigger` defaults to [`CompactTrigger::Manual`] when omitted: a client-initiated compaction is always manual by definition.

# Examples

``` use zhive_proto::rpc::CompactParams; use zhive_proto::hook::CompactTrigger; let p: CompactParams = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"threadId":"thread:native/x"}"#).unwrap(); assert_eq!(p.trigger, CompactTrigger::Manual); ```

trigger.description: Why compaction was triggered; defaults to `manual` when omitted.

oneOf.description: Engine-initiated when the context window fills.
